석굴암은 1995년 12월 불국사와 함께 유네스코 세계문화유산으로 등록되었다.
불국사는 임진왜란 때인 1593년 왜군의 방화로 크게 소실되었고, 1969~1973년 복원공사로 무설전·관음전·비로전 등이 복원되었다.

conflicts: Possibly stale sources: both official sites show 'COPYRIGHT 2018'. Editor images in the Bulguksa and Seokguram history pages are dated 2018-05, and the newest edit on the Bulguksa directions page is 2025-04. All are more than 12 months old, so mark them stale_source. The fees and hours pages carry no update date.

The two official pages differ on public transport: the Bulguksa page gives only buses 10 and 11 from 경주역 and the terminal, while the Seokguram page adds bus 700 from 신경주역. Whether 경주역 is still current needs another official source (for example the city of Gyeongju).
Secondary sources (not official) say the walk from the car park to Seokguram is about 15–20 minutes. The official page says about 10 minutes, so the official figure was kept.
Seokguram history page says '국보 제24호', an old-style designation number. Its credited source is 문화재청 (the old agency name). Treat the page as stale.

notes: I opened every cited URL myself with curl. All pages loaded and the VisitJeju body text was in the HTML.
No coordinates were cross-checked against OSM.

For collector_unconfirmed items (access, parking, duration, payment, language, reservation) I tried 1–2 web searches each. They returned only secondary sources (blogs, listings), so no claims were suggested. These still need an official source or a recorded reason they can't be confirmed.
Hyeopjae: the official page itself says tube rental and the pet and swimming-zone rules need official confirmation.
Bulguksa/Seokguram: no official pages for reservation, payment or Korean-language guides were found. The admin region 경상북도 경주시 shows no change on the official pages.
